jobs.description:
**Role Description

**Are you an experienced consultant with passion and knowledge for ERP transformations that truly change how businesses work? We are seeking applicants with extensive experience taking the lead in complex ERP transformation projects across ERP strategy, ERP sourcing, project and programme management, architecture, and business consulting.

_Please note, we are accepting applications from candidates matching Senior Consultant (3+ years) through to Principal Consultant (6+ years) levels of experience.

_**What you'll be doing:

**Working with our Business Solutions & ERP service offering, you will help leading companies succeed with ERP transformations – from design to delivery. Our approach is agnostic: we help our clients succeed with ERP transformations end to end regardless of ERP system. You will spend your time:

• Lead large-scale ERP transformationprojects and programmes.

• Advise C-level stakeholders on ERP strategy; defining project scope, business needs and execution of ERP transformations.

• Ensure delivery excellence across multiple workstreams, translating complex business requirements into scalable ERP solutions.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to bridge business and technology, translating between business stakeholders and technical teams.

• Drive business development and client relationships.

**Qualifications, We Hope You Will Bring

**

• 
A minimum of 3+years' experience as an external consultant with a focus on ERP systems or with a mix of industry work and experience as a management consultant

• 
Please note that experience working as an external consultant is a requirement for this role

• 
Relevant master's degree

• 
Fluency in both Danish and English

• 
Working knowledge of ERP software (e.g. SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics)

• 
Proven project management skills with the ability to lead and manage multiple projects simultaneously.

• 
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities

• 
Ability to work both independently and as part of a team.

This role is based out of our Copenhagen offices. A usual work week contains work at various locations: our client sites, at our office and/or at home. We embrace flexibility and hybrid work, but we also cherish physical presence with our clients and colleagues. The magic is in the balance. Applicants must be already living in Denmark

**What We Offer

**

• A vibrant and growing company where your voice matters.You’ll have real influence over how we work, collaborate, and evolve.

• A company that believes that rest is productive. Our working policies are built on trust, autonomy, and psychological safety with flexibility being a keyword.

• A clear path forward, whether you join as a Consultantor Director. We support your growth through project leadership, client impact, and contributions to thought leadership – internally and externally.

• A close-knit team of passionate people who move fast, support each other, and value initiative. From Friday breakfasts to champagne rituals for new joiners and strategy tours abroad, we celebrate and foster belonging.

• We offer a fair and transparent salary model, regularly benchmarked against market standards. Your package includes private health insurance, flexible pension contribution and optionalperkslike discounted gym memberships and monthly office massages.

**About Us

**Unify Partners is a modern management consultancy founded in 2022 by experienced partners with a shared vision: to unify business and technology in ways that truly move the needle. In just a short time, we’ve built a strong foundation for growth, now counting 36 passionate colleagues and we’re just getting started.

We believe that the best results come from bringing diverse minds together. That’s why our culture is built around collaboration and inclusion. We call it “the power of together” - combining expertise across disciplines and working closely with our customers and partners to deliver meaningful impact.

Our values are simple but powerful: we strike a balance between delivering high-impact client work and prioritising wellbeing. We grow through knowledge sharing, mentoring and hands-on experience and we all contribute towards building a workplace where belonging and social connections thrive. If you would like to see more about our culture, check out our instagram and LinkedIn @UnifyPartners

If you’re ready to join an ambitious, fast-paced and forward-thinking team – apply today, we’d love to meet you.

Lead Designer for the world’s most impactful CPR training programs

We are looking for a hands-on Lead Designer who loves great Interaction Design, UX & UI craft, and can also set direction and bring an organisation with them.

At Laerdal, we develop CPR training solutions used by healthcare professionals and organisations around the world, with a mission to help save one million more lives each year by 2030.

We are seeking an exceptional Lead Designer to join our cross-functional product team in Copenhagen, working on the psycho-motor skills experience of RQI Provider and HeartCode Complete. These are cornerstone programs in the collaboration between Laerdal Medical and the American Heart Association, reaching millions of healthcare professionals across the globe.

This is an opportunity to shape experiences that ultimately help people become better prepared to save a life.

The design challenge goes well beyond screens. Learners move between digital instruction, software-guided practice, physical interaction with manikins and training stations, assessment, and certification. Your role is to make that entire experience coherent, intuitive, and effective.

About us

In Laerdal Copenhagen we are around 150 people developing best-in-class digital learning products. We hire people with grit and mission-driven hearts, and by joining us, you will become part of a unique and dynamic workplace that appreciates diversity, authenticity, ambition, and long-term, sustainable solutions.

We are a unique mix of talents, from medical doctors and learning specialists to designers, software engineers and 3D engineers, working with international partners to deliver effective learning solutions.

Some of what we offer

• A collaborative and diverse environment with lots of passion and energy. Our workplace is friendly and casual, located in an old warehouse at Islands Brygge.

• An outstanding teamwork culture driven by the mission of helping save lives.

• Fair compensation.

• Great opportunities for growth and personal development in a global organization

About you

You are an exceptional hands-on product designer who cares deeply about craft. You are equally comfortable defining an end-to-end learner experience, working through a complex interaction, and crafting the final UI that gets built.

You enjoy getting close to users, turning insight into ideas, and making those ideas tangible through flows, prototypes and high-quality screen designs. You have a strong eye for visual and interaction design, and you care about the details that make a product feel intuitive, coherent and polished.

At Lead level, we also expect you to look beyond the individual screen or feature. You can articulate a compelling design direction, bring Product, Engineering and other stakeholders with you, and use prototypes and customer evidence to move the team from discussion to experimentation and implementation faster.

This is a hands-on design role. You will be the designer creating the UX and UI for these products, not someone handing the work over to another designer.

About the role

On this cross-functional team, you will:

• Own the UX and UI design craft for RQI Provider and HeartCode Complete.

• Design the learner experience across digital interfaces, software-guided training and physical interaction with manikins and training stations.

• Create user flows, interaction models, wireframes, prototypes and polished, implementation-ready UI designs using Laerdal’s Life Design System.

• Work closely with Engineering throughout implementation, reviewing the built experience and ensuring that design quality and intent survive through release.

• Prototype early and often, putting tangible ideas in front of learners and customers rather than relying on presentations and specifications.

• Lead discovery and collaborate with a Design Researcher on research and usability testing to understand learner needs and validate solutions.

• Build a deep understanding of healthcare professionals and their CPR learning and certification journeys through direct engagement with learners, instructors and customers.

• Shape and communicate a strong design vision for the products, creating alignment across Product, Engineering, Educational Specialists and other stakeholders.

• Help the team shorten the cycle from idea to prototype, customer test, learning and release.

• Use AI-enabled workflows to accelerate exploration, prototyping and iteration.

• Travel to the US and other markets to observe training, test solutions and work directly with customers and partners.

Qualifications

• A strong portfolio demonstrating excellent hands-on UX, interaction and UI design craft in shipped products.

• Strong visual design skills and attention to detail, with the ability to take work all the way from rough concept to production-ready interface.

• Excellent prototyping skills, from quick experiments to realistic prototypes suitable for customer testing.

• Deep understanding of user-centered design, with demonstrated experience involving users throughout the design process.

• Experience designing complex digital products where software is part of a broader physical experience is a strong advantage.

• Ability to establish a product or experience design vision and translate it into concrete design work.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to influence Product, Engineering and senior stakeholders through customer evidence and tangible design proposals.

• An AI-first mindset toward your own design toolchain and cross-functional workflows in the team.

• Experience with healthcare, medical technology, learning products or connected devices is an advantage.

• Willingness to travel internationally, particularly to the US.

If you're passionate about design and want to make a meaningful impact, we invite you to join our team at Laerdal Medical in Copenhagen. We’re looking forward to receiving your:

• Letter of motivation,

• CV, and

• Portfolio (can be a link to an online resource)

Only applications with all three will be reviewed. Beware that LinkedIn only allows one document upload, so merge them into one, before you hit the APPLY button.

Start date: ASAP.

Business Consultant, Corporate Credit, Netcompany Banking Services

• Full-time

Job Description

Are you interested in the intersection of IT, business and finance? As a Business Consultant, you will work with IT solutions supporting banks' corporate credit processes. You will analyze system issues, understand client needs and translate business requirements into technical solutions while building specialized knowledge within banking and corporate credit.

Netcompany Banking Services

We deliver various IT solutions and services to banks and savings institutions across Denmark and other Nordic countries. We provide a modern, cloud-based core banking platform serving more than 50 Nordic banks with over 2 million end customers. Our solutions encompass daily banking operations, mobile and internet banking, payments, investment management, risk management, compliance, and open banking.

Responsibilities

We are looking for a Business Consultant to join our team, working with IT solutions that support banks' corporate credit processes. You will be involved in the daily operation, maintenance and further development of these solutions, acting as a link between clients, developers and other stakeholders. Your work will involve investigating issues, understanding business needs and ensuring reliable system operations.

You will join an experienced team that will support your onboarding and help you build expertise within corporate credit and IT solutions. Initially, your focus will be on learning the existing solution and its daily operations, with opportunities to take on more responsibility for further development over time.

Your responsibilities will typically include:

• Handling and analyzing client-reported issues and tickets, investigating problems and identifying their root causes to ensure reliable system operations.

• Maintaining and supporting existing IT solutions while contributing to their continuous improvement and further development.

• Engaging in dialogue with clients to understand their needs and challenges, translating business requirements into clear and actionable tasks.

• Collaborating closely with developers and testers to investigate technical issues, clarify requirements and coordinate solutions.

• Supporting the development and implementation of new functionality through requirements analysis, testing and refinement.

You are curious, analytical and motivated by understanding how IT solutions work and how they support business processes. You enjoy investigating problems, asking questions and finding solutions in collaboration with others. Guided by our core values of Patients, Science, and Passion, we are applying our innovative TransCon® technology platform to fulfill our mission of developing new therapies that demonstrate best-in-class potential to address unmet medical needs.

At our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark, research facilities in Heidelberg, Germany, and additional offices across Europe and the United States, we are advancing programs in our Endocrinology Rare Disease and Oncology portfolios. Job title: Senior Principal Scientist – Molecular Innovation and Discovery

Department: Global Research

Location: Måløv, Denmark

**Your impact begins here

**As Senior Principal Scientist, you will play a key role in building a new interdisciplinary team in Global Research and contribute to shape how it turns emerging biology into molecular interventions. You will co-create new therapeutic concepts in cardiometabolic disease and healthspan, design the molecules that test them and establish their pharmacological potential. Your work will bring new projects into the early discovery pipeline, because lasting health starts with the science we build today.

**What You Will Bring

**You hold a PhD in medicinal chemistry, chemical biology, molecular pharmacology, peptide chemistry or a related discipline, typically complemented by at least eight years of relevant post-PhD research experience, or equivalent scientific contributions and leadership. Relevant experience may come from academia, biotechnology or the pharmaceutical industry.

• Deep expertise in molecular design and a strong understanding of how molecular properties influence pharmacological activity.

• A record of turning original ideas into experimental tools, therapeutic candidates or discovery projects, evidenced through publications, patents, project progression or other relevant contributions.

• Experience connecting chemistry with biological assays and in vivo findings to guide molecular optimisation.

• The ability to evaluate therapeutic modalities and select approaches suited to the target, mechanism and intended site of action.

• Experience leading scientific work and influencing decisions across multidisciplinary collaborations.

• Creativity, sound scientific judgement and a willingness to pursue unfamiliar approaches while testing assumptions rigorously.

• Clear scientific communication in written and spoken English.

**Useful, But Not Essential

**

• Peptide engineering, peptide–drug conjugates or targeted delivery.

• Multi-receptor pharmacology or approaches combining complementary mechanisms.

• Neuropharmacology, cardiometabolic disease or healthspan research.

• Receptor pharmacology and mechanistic assay development.

• Collaborations connecting molecular design, synthesis and biological evaluation.

You are not expected to bring expertise across every modality or therapeutic area.

**What You Will Do

**You will provide scientific leadership at the interface of molecular design, biology and experimental pharmacology.

• Originate therapeutic concepts that connect biological mechanisms with opportunities for molecular intervention, and design molecular tools and drug candidates to establish pharmacological proof of concept.

• Develop strategies involving peptides, small molecules, conjugates or other modalities, choosing the approach that fits the biological question.

• Guide iterative molecular design using findings from in vitro assays, in vivo pharmacology and relevant DMPK studies.

• Contribute hands-on to experimental research, such as molecular preparation, characterisation or pharmacological evaluation, according to project needs and available capabilities.

• Identify technologies that expand our ability to modulate biological targets or deliver pharmacological activity.

• Assess evidence critically and recommend which concepts to advance, redirect or discontinue.

• Mentor colleagues and communicate molecular strategies, findings and recommendations across disciplines.

**Who You Will Work With

**You will join a new interdisciplinary team in Global Research within Research & Development, combining expertise in physiology, pharmacology, neuroscience and molecular innovation. Day to day, you will work closely with scientists and laboratory technicians. The team, headed by Christoffer Clemmensen, is currently recruiting at multiple levels, so you contribute to shape the new team from the onset.

You are expected to establish close collaborations across the organisation with colleagues in chemistry, biology, DMPK and relevant technology functions to develop and test new therapeutic concepts. Bringing these perspectives together early helps the team make clear, evidence-based decisions at pace.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will shape the molecular innovation agenda of a new team and contribute to its first generation of discovery projects. The role combines scientific ownership with close involvement in experimental work, using emerging biological findings to guide the development of molecular approaches.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area, and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to turn emerging biology into molecular approaches that can change what we know about cardiometabolic disease and healthspan, apply for the Senior Principal Scientist – Molecular Innovation and Discovery role by 22 November 2026. We review applications on an ongoing basis, so apply as soon as you can.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

**Are you an experienced upstream scientist who enjoys solving complex process challenges and turning scientific data into clear recommendations? Do you enjoy leading late-stage development studies and using your expertise to help clients move their processes towards clinical and commercial manufacturing?

**At AGC Biologics in Søborg, we are looking for a Senior Scientist to join our Late-Stage Process Development team.

You will join a multidisciplinary team of six scientists and eight technicians working across upstream, downstream, and analytical disciplines. Together, we develop and characterize robust mammalian cell culture processes supporting clinical and commercial manufacturing.

**About The Job

**As a Senior Scientist, you will lead upstream late-stage development activities, with a particular focus on process characterization, down-scale model qualification, and scientific data analysis.

You will be responsible for your assigned scientific activities, from study design and data interpretation to technical recommendations and reporting. As a subject matter expert (SME), you will also serve as a key scientific contact for clients and internal stakeholders, helping explain process performance, address technical challenges, and recommend practical next steps.

**Your Main Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Planning and leading process characterization (PC) studies, including experimental design, data evaluation, and preparation of PC work reports.

• Designing and evaluating down-scale model qualification (DSMQ) studies to demonstrate representativeness of manufacturing-scale processes.

• Applying statistical methods, including Design of Experiments (DoE), and tools such as JMP to support data-driven scientific conclusions.

• Contributing to FMECA and other process risk assessments to identify critical process parameters and support control strategy development.

• Supporting late-stage development activities, including Limit of In Vitro Cell Age (LIVCA) studies, Working Cell Bank (WCB) activities, scale-up, and technology transfer.

• Providing scientific guidance to laboratory technicians, collaborating across functions, and communicating technical findings, project status, and recommendations to clients.

You will also contribute to technical documentation, including development reports, technology transfer documentation, and relevant regulatory submissions.

**Who Are We Looking For?

**We are looking for an experienced scientist with strong technical knowledge of mammalian upstream processes and the ability to translate scientific data into practical recommendations.

**We Imagine That You

**

• Hold a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree in biotechnology, biochemical engineering, or another relevant scientific discipline.

• Have at least five years of relevant industry experience with a Master's degree or two years with a PhD, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

• Have solid experience with mammalian cell culture processes, including bioreactor operations and scale-up.

• Have experience with late-stage process development, such as process characterization, scale-down models, or technology transfer.

• Can design studies, apply statistical methods, interpret complex data, and communicate scientifically sound conclusions.

• Have experience with process risk assessments and preparing clear scientific reports and technical documentation.

• Communicate effectively with clients and cross-functional colleagues and are fluent in written and spoken English.

Experience with JMP, DoE, AMBR250, DSMQ, FMECA, statistical equivalence testing, process modelling, or regulatory submissions will be an advantage. We recognize that candidates may bring different combinations of these skills and do not expect you to have experience with every method or technology listed.

You work independently, take responsibility for your commitments, and maintain high standards of scientific quality. You can structure your work and prioritize competing tasks, even when project requirements change.

When challenges arise, you approach them calmly and logically, communicate openly about progress and risks, and involve colleagues or your manager when support is need.

You are comfortable discussing scientific findings with clients, explaining the rationale behind your recommendations, and working with others to resolve challenges. You value mutual respect, open communication, and learning from colleagues.

**What We Offer

**At AGC Biologics, you will work on different client projects, helping prepare mammalian upstream processes for clinical and commercial manufacturing.

**We Offer

**

• The opportunity to lead late-stage upstream development studies and work on different scientific and process challenges.

• A multidisciplinary environment where scientific discussions, collaboration, and knowledge sharing are part of everyday work.

• A manager who gives you room to plan your work independently, values honest discussions, and is available when you need support.

• An initial mentoring arrangement to help you become familiar with our processes, systems, and ways of working.

• Access to our canteen arrangement, Employee Club, and employee discount opportunities.

**
